value.rationale: The 2026 source focuses on stationary wall accumulation and mean absorption time, leaving rare adsorbed-time fluctuations unresolved. The exact rate makes probability-cost asymmetry quantitative: long mobile spells contribute an explicit square-root approach at zero adsorption, whereas continuous adsorption produces a logarithmic edge, with a log-log correction revealing an initial outward rather than inward ballistic orientation. This is a specific physically motivated invariant of natural full-desorption-reset model, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
